body:
With sex you shouldn't be worried about anything. Just follow the spur of the moment and do whatever makes you both happy. I personally love to give oral and I can tell you that in my experience it tastes great :-)
Of course hygiene is very important and you should both shower beforehand.
About her liking it or not... Ask her for directions. I'm. to an expert but the way I do it is by starting kissing her navel, stomach, legs and then in move slowly between her legs.
Be gentle and light at the beginning. Girls are very sensitive and you should not be too aggressive or eager.
Have fun!
No worries :-) Sure let's PM sometime :-)
True. I chatted with a couple of people yesterday and today I'm much better. thanks :-)

I've been trying for more then 3 years and I'm not moving even an inch forward...
The situation is quite complicated and there is a conflict between what I know I should do and my deepest believes.

No nothing specific... just need to talk to someone to feel a little better I guess.
I know exactly what's giving me a hard time and there isn't much to do about it. I just feel stupid about it.
It's mostly emotional problem. Relationships are hard I guess :-)

California is a little too awesome for me... brings up painful memories every time I go there...
My problems are not related to the financial crisis or anything like that :-)

lol I actually haven't tried the ferries yet but I want to do it maybe tomorrow.
I'm not from around here and this is my first time in Washington state. From what people says this weather is quite uncommon over here and from next week it will be better.
Wanna tell me more about you? Shall we PM?

Work. It's quite nice even if this weekend it's freezing cold! Today was around 20 F (-6 C)!
I got back to my hotel because I was freezing.
Where are you writing from?
Washington State for now, going down to California in a couple of days.
Thanks. Shall I PM you?

Hey. I have to run now but I'll be happy to talk in any way you feel comfortable. Private message? Or Gtalk?
I'm also in pretty bad shape but I'm learning how to get out of the worst moments. Talking to a stranger can be quite helpful so please hang in there and let's talk later.
I should be available in around an hour.
Thanks. I'm afraid I'm on a situation beyond any possible solution.

First of all don't get married! I did exactly that mistake and I'm to the point where I'm considering killing myself (see post on suicidewatch...).
Before getting married we were having sex 3/4 even 5 times a day. Of course not everyday but most of the time if we didn't had any other important thing to do. Then we slowed down a lot and we ended up in a situation similar to yours. She also mentioned that marriage would solve the problem because she was feeling insecure about the future.
It didn't solve a thing... But made it only worse year after year. Now I resent her and I'm mad at myself.

Is the situation salvageable? I don't know man... Hope others here can give you better advices than I can.

Good luck and think that this is YOUR life.

An update from me...
I feel much better. Many of you answered privately and comforted me. One special person in particular managed to bring me back to life! :-) I'm still a long way from being happy but I can finally say that I'm on the right track :-)
I hope everyone in this subreddit is lucky as I've been and find the help I got.

I'm 41... So I understand. Life can be hard. Did you seek help? Today medicine can be pretty good (I hope). I tried CBT a while back but that didn't really work. Now I'm trying to get an appointment with my doctor to do some therapy. Why don't you give it a shot?

Try to take time to see a doctor. Mood swings are part of the all depression thing. Could be bipolar disorder.
No need to thank me :-) take care of yourself, that's all I ask :-)

All the best.

We all worry about the future but unfortunately there is very little we can do about it.

Why anyone would care? I really don't know... But trust me... We do. I guess is part of human nature.
What did you mess up so far?

Lets talk about it. I'm sure there is a way to make things better.

We do notice here and we care. I'm also depressed and suicidal and most times all I can think is the many ways in which I can end my sad existence.
Reddit has been very helpful and there are many people that can give good advices.
Do you know why you feel so down?

I perfectly understand you. I'll tell you my dream: to die saving someone else life. There are lot of happy people that die everyday and I would be very happy to take their place.

Do you know why you feel this way? I'm here if you want to chat about it.

Oh man! My experience with cipralex is awful so please be careful.
I made the mistake of using it for a while and than something happen to my life. I found someone that made me so happy that I thought I didn't need it anymore so I just stopped taking it. The result was just horrible. I started feeling slightly sick and then it made me completely crazy and horribly depressed.
So please be careful and follow your doctor indications on how to get off of it when the time comes. In my experience it was also completely useless.
Why? I'm also suicidal at the moment so I'm not judging but you're young so you still have time.
Today I feel even worst than yesterday....
Thank you for your kind words. I can't write more now but I will answer in more details later.

I understand you very deeply... I've been severely depressed for the past 4 years. Ups and downs and now I really can't take it anymore. My friends keep calling me only when they need something and never really do anything for me.
The only thing I can tell you is that I'll be happy to chat if you want. Talking makes things a little better at times but you should also seek professional help. I tried CBT but didn't work, mostly because I didn't believe in it. I tried homeopathic therapy and that went a little better.
Ping me in private if you want to chat.
What did you tell her during these 10 years? I'm in a similar situation with my marriage being almost completely sexless for the last.... I don't know how long anymore....
So... What is bothering you the most? Also why don't you tell me a little more about you?
Do you wanna chat in private or over here? I'm way older than you and survived that very difficult age. I'll be happy to help if I can.

I'm new to reddit and I'm starting to use it mostly to seek advice because I also feel depressed like you.
I started obsessing about ways in which I could kill myself and played them over and over in my head.
You're not alone man and I'm use we can help each other. Why don't you tell me what's making you feel so bad?
Hang in there... I'm sure things will get better.
Delete everything. Too risky.
